name: Afghanistan (Khalq, 1978–1980)
description: A red field with the golden Khalq emblem — the word 'khalq' in a wreath of wheat beneath a star — in the upper hoist.
history: The all-red banner of the Khalq communists after the Saur Revolution — so unpopular it helped fuel the 1979 uprising; the Soviet-installed Parcham government restored the tricolor in 1980.

features.role: Khalq calligraphy in wheat wreath under a star
